import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
HELPER = OUT.parent / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/prepare-fixture.cjs'
INVENTORY = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/source-modes.json'


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


cases = {
    'absolute-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
    'parent-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
    'duplicate-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
    'out-of-range-mode': 'inventory entry',
    'fractional-mode': 'inventory entry',
    'changed-mode-unpinned': 'inventory hash',
    'source-hash-mismatch': 'snapshot mismatch',
    'external-root': 'external fixture roots',
}
for name, expected in cases.items():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fixture-negative-', dir=OUT / 'tmp') as temp:
        root = Path(temp)
        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
        snapshot.mkdir()
        output.mkdir()
        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
        source.write_bytes(b'fixture\n')
        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=sha(source.read_bytes()), mode=0o755)
        if name == 'out-of-range-mode':
            entry['mode'] = 512
        if name == 'fractional-mode':
            entry['mode'] = 1.5
        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
        inventory_file = snapshot / INVENTORY
        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        raw = json.dumps(inventory).encode()
        inventory_file.write_bytes(raw)
        allowed = [dict(path=INVENTORY, sha256=sha(raw)), dict(path=entry['path'], sha256=entry['sha256'])]
        if name == 'absolute-path':
            allowed.append(dict(path=str(output / 'escape'), sha256='0' * 64))
        if name == 'parent-path':
            allowed.append(dict(path='../escape', sha256='0' * 64))
        if name == 'duplicate-path':
            allowed.append(allowed[-1].copy())
        if name == 'changed-mode-unpinned':
            inventory['entries'][0]['mode'] = 0o644
            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
        if name == 'source-hash-mismatch':
            source.write_bytes(b'changed fixture\n')
        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
        target = output
        if name == 'external-root':
            target = root / 'wrong-output'
            target.mkdir()
        before = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): (sha(p.read_bytes()), p.stat().st_mode) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
        command = ['rtk', 'proxy', 'node', str(HELPER), str(manifest), str(snapshot), str(target)]
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(json.dumps(dict(case=name, argv=command, exit_code=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)))
        assert result.returncode != 0 and expected in result.stderr, name
        assert not (output / 'work').exists() and not (output / 'git-history.git').exists(), name
        after = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): (sha(p.read_bytes()), p.stat().st_mode) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
        assert before == after, name
print('8 expected helper rejections verified; synthetic fixture bytes and modes unchanged')

+
+
+def sha(raw):
+    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+
+
+cases = {
+    'absolute-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'parent-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'duplicate-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'out-of-range-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'fractional-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'changed-mode-unpinned': 'inventory hash',
+    'source-hash-mismatch': 'snapshot mismatch',
+    'external-root': 'external fixture roots',
+}
+for name, expected in cases.items():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fixture-negative-', dir=OUT / 'tmp') as temp:
+        root = Path(temp)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir()
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_bytes(b'fixture\n')
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=sha(source.read_bytes()), mode=0o755)
+        if name == 'out-of-range-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if name == 'fractional-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 1.5
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        inventory_file = snapshot / INVENTORY
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        raw = json.dumps(inventory).encode()

+            allowed.append(dict(path='../escape', sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'duplicate-path':
+            allowed.append(allowed[-1].copy())
+        if name == 'changed-mode-unpinned':
+            inventory['entries'][0]['mode'] = 0o644
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))

+import datetime

+import sys

+
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WORK = OUT / 'work'
+EVIDENCE = WORK / 'specs/shared-review-launch-repair/verification/T-005/attempt-6'
+env = os.environ.copy()
+env.update({
+    'TMPDIR': str(OUT / 'tmp'), 'TMP': str(OUT / 'tmp'), 'TEMP': str(OUT / 'tmp'),
+    'TMPPREFIX': str(OUT / 'tmp/zsh'), 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1',
+    'XDG_CACHE_HOME': str(OUT / 'tmp/cache'), 'XDG_CONFIG_HOME': str(OUT / 'tmp/config'),
+    'XDG_DATA_HOME': str(OUT / 'tmp/data'), 'DOTNET_CLI_HOME': str(OUT / 'tmp/dotnet'),
+    'DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT': '1', 'DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE': '1',
+    'GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM': '1', 'GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL': '/dev/null',
+    'GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES': str(OUT), 'GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT': '0',
+    'T005_SOURCE_GIT_ROOT': str(OUT / 'git-history.git'),
+})
+
+
+def run(label, argv, cwd=WORK, destination=EVIDENCE):
+    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    start = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+    t = time.monotonic()
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', *argv]
+    with (destination / (label + '.log')).open('wb') as log:
+        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+                                stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+    record = dict(label=label, argv=command, cwd=str(cwd), stdin='DEVNULL',
+                  environment={k: env[k] for k in env if k in (
+                      'TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP', 'TMPPREFIX', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE',
+                      'XDG_CACHE_HOME', 'XDG_CONFIG_HOME', 'XDG_DATA_HOME', 'DOTNET_CLI_HOME',
+                      'GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM', 'GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL', 'GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES',
+                      'T005_SOURCE_GIT_ROOT')}, started_at=start,
+                  finished_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                  duration_seconds=round(time.monotonic()-t, 3), exit_code=result.returncode)
+    (destination / (label + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
+    print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
+    print((destination / (label + '.log')).read_text(errors='replace')[-2500:], flush=True)
+    return result.returncode
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    if sys.argv[1] == 'prepare':
+        base = OUT.parent
+        rc = run('prepare-fixture', ['node', str(base / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/prepare-fixture.cjs'),
+                 str(base / 'manifest.json'), str(base / 'snapshot'), str(OUT)], OUT, OUT / 'tmp/preparation')
+        if rc == 0:

+        sys.exit(rc)

+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+HELPER = OUT.parent / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/prepare-fixture.cjs'
+INVENTORY = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/source-modes.json'
+
+
+def sha(raw):
+    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+
+
+cases = {
+    'absolute-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'parent-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'duplicate-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'out-of-range-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'fractional-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'changed-mode-unpinned': 'inventory hash',
+    'source-hash-mismatch': 'snapshot mismatch',
+    'external-root': 'external fixture roots',
+}
+for name, expected in cases.items():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fixture-negative-', dir=OUT / 'tmp') as temp:
+        root = Path(temp)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir()
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_bytes(b'fixture\n')
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=sha(source.read_bytes()), mode=0o755)
+        if name == 'out-of-range-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if name == 'fractional-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 1.5
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        inventory_file = snapshot / INVENTORY
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        raw = json.dumps(inventory).encode()
+        inventory_file.write_bytes(raw)
+        allowed = [dict(path=INVENTORY, sha256=sha(raw)), dict(path=entry['path'], sha256=entry['sha256'])]
+        if name == 'absolute-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path=str(output / 'escape'), sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'parent-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path='../escape', sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'duplicate-path':
+            allowed.append(allowed[-1].copy())
+        if name == 'changed-mode-unpinned':
+            inventory['entries'][0]['mode'] = 0o644
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        if name == 'source-hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_bytes(b'changed fixture\n')
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+        target = output
+        if name == 'external-root':
+            target = root / 'wrong-output'
+            target.mkdir()
+        before = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): (sha(p.read_bytes()), p.stat().st_mode) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+        command = ['rtk', 'proxy', 'node', str(HELPER), str(manifest), str(snapshot), str(target)]
+        result = subprocess.run(command, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True)
+        print(json.dumps(dict(case=name, argv=command, exit_code=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)))
+        assert result.returncode != 0 and expected in result.stderr, name
+        assert not (output / 'work').exists() and not (output / 'git-history.git').exists(), name
+        after = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): (sha(p.read_bytes()), p.stat().st_mode) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+        assert before == after, name
+print('8 expected helper rejections verified; synthetic fixture bytes and modes unchanged')

+

+```
+
+Work stopped at that refusal. The user then authorized named-variable-only diagnostics. The `printenv TMPDIR TMP TEMP TMPPREFIX` probe did not establish the unexported shell variable. The subsequent `typeset -p TMPPREFIX TMPDIR TMP TEMP` probe showed shell TMPPREFIX `/tmp/zsh`, while TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP pointed to this attempt's output/tmp.

The authorized builtin diagnostic confirmed the corrected variables; the authorized Python here-document printed:

+TMP_PREFIX_HEREDOC_OK
+```
+
+That diagnostic exited 0. The user explicitly authorized continuation of the original bounded revalidation afterward. The refusal and diagnostic are retained as history; neither is a regression result, native model launch proof, or a formal review verdict. Fresh regression execution records begin with `prepare-fixture.json` and the named suite JSON/log pairs in this directory. `environment-versions.log` independently records the currently observed four temporary variables.

+

+
+
+def sha(raw):
+    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+
+
+cases = {
+    'absolute-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'parent-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'duplicate-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'out-of-range-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'fractional-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'changed-mode-unpinned': 'inventory hash',
+    'source-hash-mismatch': 'snapshot mismatch',
+    'external-root': 'external fixture roots',
+}
+for name, expected in cases.items():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fixture-negative-', dir=OUT / 'tmp') as temp:
+        root = Path(temp)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir()
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_bytes(b'fixture\n')
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=sha(source.read_bytes()), mode=0o755)
+        if name == 'out-of-range-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if name == 'fractional-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 1.5
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        inventory_file = snapshot / INVENTORY
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        raw = json.dumps(inventory).encode()
+        inventory_file.write_bytes(raw)
+        allowed = [dict(path=INVENTORY, sha256=sha(raw)), dict(path=entry['path'], sha256=entry['sha256'])]
+        if name == 'absolute-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path=str(output / 'escape'), sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'parent-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path='../escape', sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'duplicate-path':
+            allowed.append(allowed[-1].copy())
+        if name == 'changed-mode-unpinned':
+            inventory['entries'][0]['mode'] = 0o644
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        if name == 'source-hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_bytes(b'changed fixture\n')
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'

+            target = root / 'wrong-output'

+        after = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): (sha(p.read_bytes()), p.stat().st_mode) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+        assert before == after, name

+def run(label, argv, cwd=WORK, destination=EVIDENCE):

+                      'GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM', 'GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL', 'GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES',
+                      'T005_SOURCE_GIT_ROOT')}, started_at=start,
+                  finished_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                  duration_seconds=round(time.monotonic()-t, 3), exit_code=result.returncode)
+    (destination / (label + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
+    print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)

+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+HELPER = OUT.parent / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/prepare-fixture.cjs'
+INVENTORY = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/source-modes.json'
+
+
+def sha(raw):
+    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+
+
+cases = {
+    'absolute-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'parent-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'duplicate-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'out-of-range-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'fractional-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'changed-mode-unpinned': 'inventory hash',
+    'source-hash-mismatch': 'snapshot mismatch',
+    'external-root': 'external fixture roots',
+}
+for name, expected in cases.items():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fixture-negative-', dir=OUT / 'tmp') as temp:
+        root = Path(temp)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir()
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_bytes(b'fixture\n')
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=sha(source.read_bytes()), mode=0o755)
+        if name == 'out-of-range-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if name == 'fractional-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 1.5
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        inventory_file = snapshot / INVENTORY
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        raw = json.dumps(inventory).encode()
+        inventory_file.write_bytes(raw)
+        allowed = [dict(path=INVENTORY, sha256=sha(raw)), dict(path=entry['path'], sha256=entry['sha256'])]
+        if name == 'absolute-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path=str(output / 'escape'), sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'parent-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path='../escape', sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'duplicate-path':
+            allowed.append(allowed[-1].copy())
+        if name == 'changed-mode-unpinned':
+            inventory['entries'][0]['mode'] = 0o644
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        if name == 'source-hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_bytes(b'changed fixture\n')
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+        target = output
+        if name == 'external-root':
+            target = root / 'wrong-output'
+            target.mkdir()
+        before = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): (sha(p.read_bytes()), p.stat().st_mode) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+        command = ['rtk', 'proxy', 'node', str(HELPER), str(manifest), str(snapshot), str(target)]
+        result = subprocess.run(command, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True)
+        print(json.dumps(dict(case=name, argv=command, exit_code=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)))
+        assert result.returncode != 0 and expected in result.stderr, name
+        assert not (output / 'work').exists() and not (output / 'git-history.git').exists(), name
+        after = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): (sha(p.read_bytes()), p.stat().st_mode) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+        assert before == after, name
+print('8 expected helper rejections verified; synthetic fixture bytes and modes unchanged')

+

+
+
+def sha(raw):
+    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+
+
+cases = {
+    'absolute-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'parent-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'duplicate-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'out-of-range-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'fractional-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'changed-mode-unpinned': 'inventory hash',
+    'source-hash-mismatch': 'snapshot mismatch',
+    'external-root': 'external fixture roots',
+}
+for name, expected in cases.items():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fixture-negative-', dir=OUT / 'tmp') as temp:
+        root = Path(temp)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir()
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_bytes(b'fixture\n')
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=sha(source.read_bytes()), mode=0o755)
+        if name == 'out-of-range-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if name == 'fractional-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 1.5
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        inventory_file = snapshot / INVENTORY
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        raw = json.dumps(inventory).encode()
+        inventory_file.write_bytes(raw)
+        allowed = [dict(path=INVENTORY, sha256=sha(raw)), dict(path=entry['path'], sha256=entry['sha256'])]
+        if name == 'absolute-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path=str(output / 'escape'), sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'parent-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path='../escape', sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'duplicate-path':
+            allowed.append(allowed[-1].copy())
+        if name == 'changed-mode-unpinned':
+            inventory['entries'][0]['mode'] = 0o644
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        if name == 'source-hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_bytes(b'changed fixture\n')
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'

+        target = output

+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+HELPER = OUT.parent / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/prepare-fixture.cjs'
+INVENTORY = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/source-modes.json'
+
+
+def sha(raw):
+    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+
+
+cases = {
+    'absolute-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'parent-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'duplicate-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'out-of-range-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'fractional-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'changed-mode-unpinned': 'inventory hash',
+    'source-hash-mismatch': 'snapshot mismatch',
+    'external-root': 'external fixture roots',
+}
+for name, expected in cases.items():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fixture-negative-', dir=OUT / 'tmp') as temp:
+        root = Path(temp)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir()
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_bytes(b'fixture\n')
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=sha(source.read_bytes()), mode=0o755)
+        if name == 'out-of-range-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if name == 'fractional-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 1.5
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        inventory_file = snapshot / INVENTORY
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        raw = json.dumps(inventory).encode()
+        inventory_file.write_bytes(raw)
+        allowed = [dict(path=INVENTORY, sha256=sha(raw)), dict(path=entry['path'], sha256=entry['sha256'])]
+        if name == 'absolute-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path=str(output / 'escape'), sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'parent-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path='../escape', sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'duplicate-path':
+            allowed.append(allowed[-1].copy())
+        if name == 'changed-mode-unpinned':
+            inventory['entries'][0]['mode'] = 0o644
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        if name == 'source-hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_bytes(b'changed fixture\n')
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+        target = output
+        if name == 'external-root':
+            target = root / 'wrong-output'
+            target.mkdir()
+        before = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): (sha(p.read_bytes()), p.stat().st_mode) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}

+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+HELPER = OUT.parent / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/prepare-fixture.cjs'
+INVENTORY = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/source-modes.json'
+
+
+def sha(raw):
+    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+
+
+cases = {
+    'absolute-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'parent-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'duplicate-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'out-of-range-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'fractional-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'changed-mode-unpinned': 'inventory hash',
+    'source-hash-mismatch': 'snapshot mismatch',
+    'external-root': 'external fixture roots',
+}
+for name, expected in cases.items():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fixture-negative-', dir=OUT / 'tmp') as temp:
+        root = Path(temp)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir()
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_bytes(b'fixture\n')
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=sha(source.read_bytes()), mode=0o755)
+        if name == 'out-of-range-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if name == 'fractional-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 1.5
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        inventory_file = snapshot / INVENTORY
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        raw = json.dumps(inventory).encode()
+        inventory_file.write_bytes(raw)
+        allowed = [dict(path=INVENTORY, sha256=sha(raw)), dict(path=entry['path'], sha256=entry['sha256'])]
+        if name == 'absolute-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path=str(output / 'escape'), sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'parent-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path='../escape', sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'duplicate-path':
+            allowed.append(allowed[-1].copy())
+        if name == 'changed-mode-unpinned':
+            inventory['entries'][0]['mode'] = 0o644
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        if name == 'source-hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_bytes(b'changed fixture\n')
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+        target = output
+        if name == 'external-root':
+            target = root / 'wrong-output'
+            target.mkdir()
+        before = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): (sha(p.read_bytes()), p.stat().st_mode) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+        command = ['rtk', 'proxy', 'node', str(HELPER), str(manifest), str(snapshot), str(target)]
+        result = subprocess.run(command, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True)
+        print(json.dumps(dict(case=name, argv=command, exit_code=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)))
+        assert result.returncode != 0 and expected in result.stderr, name
+        assert not (output / 'work').exists() and not (output / 'git-history.git').exists(), name
+        after = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): (sha(p.read_bytes()), p.stat().st_mode) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+        assert before == after, name
+print('8 expected helper rejections verified; synthetic fixture bytes and modes unchanged')

+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+HELPER = OUT.parent / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/prepare-fixture.cjs'
+INVENTORY = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/source-modes.json'
+
+
+def sha(raw):
+    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+
+
+cases = {
+    'absolute-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'parent-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'duplicate-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'out-of-range-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'fractional-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'changed-mode-unpinned': 'inventory hash',
+    'source-hash-mismatch': 'snapshot mismatch',
+    'external-root': 'external fixture roots',
+}
+for name, expected in cases.items():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fixture-negative-', dir=OUT / 'tmp') as temp:
+        root = Path(temp)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir()
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_bytes(b'fixture\n')
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=sha(source.read_bytes()), mode=0o755)
+        if name == 'out-of-range-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if name == 'fractional-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 1.5
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        inventory_file = snapshot / INVENTORY
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        raw = json.dumps(inventory).encode()
+        inventory_file.write_bytes(raw)
+        allowed = [dict(path=INVENTORY, sha256=sha(raw)), dict(path=entry['path'], sha256=entry['sha256'])]
+        if name == 'absolute-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path=str(output / 'escape'), sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'parent-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path='../escape', sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'duplicate-path':
+            allowed.append(allowed[-1].copy())
+        if name == 'changed-mode-unpinned':
+            inventory['entries'][0]['mode'] = 0o644
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        if name == 'source-hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_bytes(b'changed fixture\n')
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+        target = output
+        if name == 'external-root':
+            target = root / 'wrong-output'
+            target.mkdir()
+        before = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): (sha(p.read_bytes()), p.stat().st_mode) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+        command = ['rtk', 'proxy', 'node', str(HELPER), str(manifest), str(snapshot), str(target)]
+        result = subprocess.run(command, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True)
+        print(json.dumps(dict(case=name, argv=command, exit_code=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)))
+        assert result.returncode != 0 and expected in result.stderr, name
+        assert not (output / 'work').exists() and not (output / 'git-history.git').exists(), name
+        after = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): (sha(p.read_bytes()), p.stat().st_mode) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+        assert before == after, name

+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+HELPER = OUT.parent / 'snapshot/handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/prepare-fixture.cjs'
+INVENTORY = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-6/source-modes.json'
+
+
+def sha(raw):
+    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+
+
+cases = {
+    'absolute-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'parent-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'duplicate-path': 'duplicate/unsafe input',
+    'out-of-range-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'fractional-mode': 'inventory entry',
+    'changed-mode-unpinned': 'inventory hash',
+    'source-hash-mismatch': 'snapshot mismatch',
+    'external-root': 'external fixture roots',
+}
+for name, expected in cases.items():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fixture-negative-', dir=OUT / 'tmp') as temp:
+        root = Path(temp)
+        snapshot, output = root / 'snapshot', root / 'output'
+        snapshot.mkdir()
+        output.mkdir()
+        source = snapshot / 'fixture.txt'
+        source.write_bytes(b'fixture\n')
+        entry = dict(path='fixture.txt', sha256=sha(source.read_bytes()), mode=0o755)
+        if name == 'out-of-range-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 512
+        if name == 'fractional-mode':
+            entry['mode'] = 1.5
+        inventory = dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=[entry])
+        inventory_file = snapshot / INVENTORY
+        inventory_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        raw = json.dumps(inventory).encode()
+        inventory_file.write_bytes(raw)
+        allowed = [dict(path=INVENTORY, sha256=sha(raw)), dict(path=entry['path'], sha256=entry['sha256'])]
+        if name == 'absolute-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path=str(output / 'escape'), sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'parent-path':
+            allowed.append(dict(path='../escape', sha256='0' * 64))
+        if name == 'duplicate-path':
+            allowed.append(allowed[-1].copy())
+        if name == 'changed-mode-unpinned':
+            inventory['entries'][0]['mode'] = 0o644
+            inventory_file.write_text(json.dumps(inventory))
+        if name == 'source-hash-mismatch':
+            source.write_bytes(b'changed fixture\n')
+        manifest = root / 'manifest.json'
+        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+        target = output
+        if name == 'external-root':
+            target = root / 'wrong-output'
+            target.mkdir()
+        before = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): (sha(p.read_bytes()), p.stat().st_mode) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+        command = ['rtk', 'proxy', 'node', str(HELPER), str(manifest), str(snapshot), str(target)]
+        result = subprocess.run(command, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True)
+        print(json.dumps(dict(case=name, argv=command, exit_code=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr)))
+        assert result.returncode != 0 and expected in result.stderr, name
+        assert not (output / 'work').exists() and not (output / 'git-history.git').exists(), name
+        after = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): (sha(p.read_bytes()), p.stat().st_mode) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+        assert before == after, name
+print('8 expected helper rejections verified; synthetic fixture bytes and modes unchanged')
